So R1CS-SOUND and R1CS-COMPLETE stay 0. fun-circuits/int-mulpow-shl-checked-128.lisp covers width 128 for both signednesses, with variable operands and any magnitude width of at least 2 bits (u8/u16/u32). The constant-base two.pow_checked at u128 is int-pow-two-checked-128-gadget, with -sound/-complete against int-pow-checked-spec 2 e nil 128. Its model: iteration 1 is fully constant-folded (the result bits are the linear combinations 1-b1 and b1).
